brief: US-Iran strikes escalate in the Strait of Hormuz, while catastrophic floods hit Nepal and the Grand Canyon, highlighting climate risks. Research focuses on AI alignment with religious plurality and immersive visualization techniques.
news_summary: US and Iran exchanged strikes for the first time in weeks, with Iran retaliating against US airbases. Meanwhile, flash floods in Nepal and the Grand Canyon caused deaths and missing persons, and Turkmenistan began fixing methane leaks.
papers_summary: Papers explore transparency rendering in CAD, AI alignment with Hinduism, and mixed reality in medical visualization, among other human-computer interaction topics.
